en: {spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Lovely weather, {name:0080}. It's been a while since we walked like this...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Say, may I ask you something?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Once this battle is all over, what do you intend to do?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}I don't know yet what I'll do once there's peace...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}...I see. Have you never thought of staying in this world?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}Huh?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}We've finally grown close. It would be lonely to say goodbye now, wouldn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Well?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}｛Promise to stay｝｛I won't stay｝{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I'll need Gabriel-sama to understand, but I intend to try my best to stay on earth.{n}{wait}{clear}{ec}{eb}{f5:3781}{n}{ea:3881}{n}{e6}{ee:0180}{n}{e8:0180}{n}{e9:0180}{n}{ed}{eb}{spk:0080}{n}...I see.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Thank goodness...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Then I'll still be able to see you after the fighting is over.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}Yes, probably.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Then once there's peace, let's go out for a drink together again, shall we?{n}{fd:0B80E6830180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:E783}{n}My mission isn't over yet, so I can't promise you now that I'll stay on earth.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I see... How lonely.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You're rather fun to be with, so I thought we might see each other now and then... What a shame.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}I'm sorry...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It's all right. Your duty as an angel must be what matters... Don't worry about someone like me.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}...Angel. There's something I'd like to ask you...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}What is it, Tia?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Once this world is back to normal, will you go back to Heaven, Angel...?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}That isn't decided yet.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I see...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I... want to stay by your side from now on, Angel. Always.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}Since some time ago... morning, noon and night... I haven't been able to stop thinking about you, Angel...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Please. Don't... go back to Heaven.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I know very well that it's selfish. But... this is the first time I've ever felt like this...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}...Please... let me stay by your side, Angel... always...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}｛Promise to stay｝｛Can't promise｝{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I understand.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}What...?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}If you say so, Tia, I'll try my best to stay on earth.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}Because I... want to be by your side too, Tia, just as you do.{n}{wait}{clear}{ec}{eb}{f5:3981}{n}{ea:3A81}{n}{e6}{ee:0180}{n}{e8:0180}{n}{e9:0180}{n}{ed}{eb}{spk:0080}{n}Thank goodness...... Thank you so much...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I have to tell Grandfather and Grandmother properly, too...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'm so... happy. ...I-I'm sorry... I've started crying...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}For you, Angel, I'll work even harder, at my hero's work and the housework too!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}From now on, always... I'll follow you, Angel...{n}{fd:0C80E6830180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I'm sorry. I can't promise right now that I'll stay on earth.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}......{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}It would go beyond what an angel is permitted.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}...O-of course not...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I should be grateful just to have met you, Angel, and yet I...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Please forgive me... for saying something so strange. ...I'm truly sorry...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Oh... You arrived sooner than I expected.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What can I do for you?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0180}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did you need something?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}Nothing much. I called you because I wanted to see what an angel's resolve looks like...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}｛You called me for that?　　｝{n}{f7:0080}｛Is something troubling you?｝{n}{f7:0080}｛If not, I'll be going.　　　｝{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}No... I meant no harm by it, but I've troubled you.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Still, I see how you feel now. I'm counting on you from here on.{n}{fd:018000800380}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6580}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}No... I meant no harm by it, but I've troubled you. Forgive me.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Still, I see how you feel now. I'm counting on you from here on.{n}{fd:018000800380}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:C880}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}No, nothing like that. It seems I made you worry for nothing. My apologies.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}But since you've come all this way, shall we talk a while...{n}{fd:018000800580}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2C81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}I see... If you're going back, that's fine. Sorry to bother you.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2D81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}I see... If you're going back, that's fine. Sorry to make you come.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Sorry to make you come all this way. Is it all right?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}No, I'm fine.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I see. Well, it's nothing very important.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0180}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Yes, it's fine. Has something happened?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}No... Well, it's nothing very important.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}｛What is it? Are you worried?｝{n}{f7:0080}｛That isn't like you, Sievas.｝{n}{f7:0080}｛It's nothing important?　　｝{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}No... I just wanted to talk a little.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}It's not the kind of trouble you're expecting, though. Keep me company for a while...{n}{fd:018000800380}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6580}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}No... I just wanted to talk with you a little.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}It's not the kind of trouble you're expecting, at least. But keep me company for a while...{n}{fd:018000800380}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:C880}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}I see, it isn't like me... I only wanted to talk, and that's how you put it.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Well, never mind. Keep me company a while.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:C980}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Good grief, you seem to have the wrong idea about me. I only wanted to talk, and that's how you put it.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You're colder than I thought. Well, never mind. Keep me company a while.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2C81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}You look disappointed. I only wanted to talk a little, and you make a face like that.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}If you're that unwilling to keep me company, then go on home.{n}{fd:018000800580}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2D81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}You look disappointed. I only wanted to talk a little, and you make a face like that.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}So you won't even listen unless it's something serious? Enough. Go home.{n}{fd:018000800580}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Sorry to call you out so suddenly. You weren't busy?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0180}{n}{spk:E783}{n}No, it's fine. It's for you, Sievas.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}I see... I'm grateful to hear that. Is it all right? If I take a little of your time?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0B80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}｛What will you tell me about?｝{n}{f7:0080}｛But not for too long...　　｝{n}{f7:0080}｛Yes. Of course...　　　　　｝{n}{end}

{fb:6580}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Let me see... You'll listen quietly to anything I say.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I've talked with many women, but rarely have I met anyone who listens as well as you...{n}{fd:018000800580}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:C980}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}I see, you're busy. I suppose you can't always indulge my whims.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Well, it can't be helped. Once this world is at peace, we'll be able to talk at leisure...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}And for that, I must do my part.{n}{fd:018000800380}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2D81}{n}{spk:E783}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Thank you... But being with you is enough for me.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}I must work hard so that we can have more time like this, even a little.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}At last you've come. I thought you weren't coming.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What's the matter?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0180}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What is it?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}Nothing much. I thought I'd give you this.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:E783}{n}A {name:0280}.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}So you like it... I never expected you to be this pleased.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Well, that's all I wanted. Sorry to call you out.{n}{fd:018000800580}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6580}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}So you like it... I never expected you to be this pleased.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}That's all I wanted. Sorry to call you out.{n}{fd:018000800580}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:C880}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I see... Well, keep it anyway. It may come in handy.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...That's all I wanted. Sorry to call you out.{n}{fd:018000800380}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2C81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Good grief, you can't even accept such a small gift...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}My business is done. You may go back.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2D81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Good grief, you can't even accept such a small gift...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}My business is done. You're free to go back.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}It's been a long while, {name:0080}.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What is it, Sievas?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0180}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What's wrong, Sievas?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}You're the one who asked me to be a hero, aren't you? And yet you hardly come with any requests... What exactly do you intend?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}｛Sorry. I'll ask next time.　｝{n}{f7:0080}｛I was just about to visit.　｝{n}{f7:0080}｛I had nothing to ask of you.｝{n}{end}
{fb:0B80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}｛Sorry. I'll ask next time.　｝{n}{f7:0080}｛I was just about to visit.　｝{n}{f7:0080}｛I had nothing to ask of you.｝{n}{end}
{fb:6480}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}Yes, I'd like you to. Otherwise I can't see why I became a hero at all.{n}{fd:018000800180}{n}{fe:018002800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:C880}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}Good grief, how convenient. Well, fine. I'll let it go this time. From now on, come properly.{n}{fe:018002800180}{n}{fd:018001800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2C81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}Oh... So you can't trust even a hero you chose yourself. Enough. Go home and cool your head.{n}{fe:018000800180}{n}{fd:018001800180}{n}{fd:018002800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Good grief, so you finally show up...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What is it, Sievas?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0180}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What's the matter, Sievas?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}A word of warning. I said I'd be a hero. But I never agreed to be your servant.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Is working your heroes to the bone how you angels do things?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}｛I'm sorry...　　　　　　　｝{n}{f7:0080}｛Can't you try a bit more?｝{n}{f7:0080}｛Even if you say that...　｝{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}Only now, after I spell it out, do you notice... Angels truly don't understand human feelings.{n}{fd:018000800180}{n}{fe:018001800180}{n}{fe:018002800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:C880}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}If telling me to try harder made it so, we wouldn't be having this talk. Enough. Go home.{n}{fe:018001800180}{n}{fd:018002800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2C81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}Heh... I understand perfectly. Just my luck, to be chosen as a hero by an angel like this.{n}{fe:018000800180}{n}{fd:018001800180}{n}{fd:018002800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...... It's you...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What is it, Reiv?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}No... It wasn't really worth making you come all this way...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
